user.title: Set up a MixPad
user.description: Enter the LAN IP of one MixPad and its ORVIBO account. Enable cloud access to discover and import the supported type-1 lights belonging to this panel. No device IDs or JSON are needed for cloud setup. The IP you enter is explicitly trusted, including firmware that omits its gateway UID. USA is verified; China is upstream-documented only. Advanced local-only setup requires relay metadata in the optional JSON field.

init.description: To add another MixPad or change its address, enter its LAN IP below. Cloud inventory imports its supported lights automatically and keeps the existing panels. Leave the IP blank to change only polling options. Cloud access is optional; disabling it retains cached metadata for local control.
